## papers 3.0.0b3

Security fix: the fields of an entry could place its files outside the files
directory (advisory GHSA-wpv4-qjwr-v5pg, reported by Artur Chlebicki,
@Artur12555). The year, journal, key and doi of an entry went into the file
name as they are, so that a year such as `/../../../x` in an imported bibtex
moved or copied its file outside the library. Their path separators are now
replaced with `-`, and a rename whose target is outside the files directory
leaves the files where they are, with an error. This also refuses a name
template with `..` or an absolute path.

Otherwise the same as 3.0.0b2. The same fix is in papers 2.19.6.
